summary: Oaktree Specialty Lending Corp filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Ninth Supplemental Indenture with Deutsche Bank Trust Company Americas as trustee, covering a $300.0 million issuance of 7.000% unsecured Notes due 2031 as part of a previously announced public offering. Interest pays semiannually each March 16 and September 16 beginning March 16, 2027, with maturity September 16, 2031. Proceeds are earmarked to reduce senior secured revolving credit facility borrowings and for general corporate purposes, including possible repayment of 2.700% notes due 2027. This is an ordinary debt capital-markets takedown, not a special situation; watch spread performance and future reborrowing leverage.
